_comment: Symbols a launch-scope surface may import from client/src/concept2cure/v2/fixtures/. Every entry is a reference constant, configuration map or pure function — the folder name predates the de-mock work. A record array (invented projects, documents, tasks, users) must never be added here; it belongs behind useSampleRows + SampleDataBanner or nowhere. Reviewed 2026-09-20 against each export's definition.
